name: Bandit scout
description: A scout who finds the sword, tricks his warchief into oni, and becomes a great bandit chief.

description_citations.text: "Pipe". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In sword form Pipe is found by a scout, who tricks his warchief into the oni's ravine and takes the sword and pendant.
timeline.quote: The scout waited until the echoes of their screams died

citation.text: "Pipe", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The scout becomes chief with the flaming sword and unites tribes in an alliance, winning victories over samurai forts.
timeline.quote: the scout had risen higher than any chief before him, bringing several tribes together in an alliance

citation.text: "Pipe", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The scout is killed by akki after the sword slips from his hand.
timeline.quote: The Akki smashed his head with a rock moments later and he fell to his death.

citation.text: "Pipe", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
